I’m Rachel Knott, an animal communicator, teacher and zoopharmacognosy practitioner and mentor.

On this channel I share insights into animal communication, plant self-selection and how we can listen more deeply to the animals in our lives.

I’m also co-host of the Unruly by Nature podcast.
